what.text: This page follows refugees from Afghanistan living in Hungary, as counted by UNHCR at the end of each year.
At the end of 2025, UNHCR counted 333 Afghan refugees in Hungary, 0.0% of all refugees from Afghanistan.
Pakistan and Iran host the most Afghan refugees, followed by Germany and France.

why.text: UCDP records armed conflict over the government of Afghanistan in every year from 1988 to 2025, at war level in most of them.
It also records armed conflict with the Islamic State group from 2015 to 2025.

when.text: UNHCR's series for this group starts in 1993 at 15 refugees.
The figure was at its highest, 2497, at the end of 2004; the main years of displacement in the data are 2002 to 2011 and 2017 to 2024.

how.text: The sources don't say which routes people took or where they live in Hungary.
These are year-end totals for Hungary only, reported to UNHCR.
